issue_context.title: Sort projects alphabetically
issue_context.body:
Currently, projects can only be sorted by `Oldest`, `Recently updated`, `Least recently updated` (see [here](https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/blob/main/templates/projects/list.tmpl#L36-L38)) 

I would like to be able to sort them alphabetically.

review_comments: Wouldn't it be better to use a-z/z-a?
I just copied it from [repo list](https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/blob/main/templates/admin/user/list.tmpl#L49). So I think it should be kept consistent.
